sloka: सुषेण दुहिता च इयम् अर्थ सूक्ष्म विनिश्चये ।औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता ॥४-२२-१३॥
transliteration: suṣeṇa duhitā ca iyam artha sūkṣma viniścaye ।autpātike ca vividhe sarvataḥ pariniṣṭhitā ॥4-22-13॥

translations.english: 'Tara, daughter of Sushena, is wise and efficient in discerning subtle matters and in foreseeing unexpected events.
